description: Medina Clean lets you book a house, apartment, condo, or small-business cleaning with Rosa Medina near Woodstock, Marietta, Kennesaw, Acworth, Canton, and Roswell, GA - right from your chat. Check whether your ZIP is in the service area, get an instant starting estimate, and send Rosa an appointment request. The assistant only sends a request: Rosa reviews the address, timing, and property and contacts you to confirm the final price and schedule - it never confirms a booking on its own. Bilingual (English/Spanish). No account or payment required.
